title: Letter from Richard H. Truly
slide_intent: Explain why colleagues should adopt a common visual system. A signed institutional letter can connect the details in a manual to decisions people make throughout the organization.
strategic_value: NASA can frame graphics as a shared agency responsibility. The letter connects the new logotype with communications ranging from publications to vehicles and signage.
demonstration: A letter addressed to colleagues introduces the visual system and asks employees for their support. The administrator’s signature and printed name close a single column of prose.
practical_value: Use this page to explain the stated rationale for adoption and the audience expected to maintain the standards.

content_islands.name: Address and letter
content_islands.spec: Keep the address and paragraphs in one column at the right, with a broad empty left margin.

content_islands.name: Signature
content_islands.spec: Close beneath the text with the handwritten signature, Richard H. Truly’s name and his Administrator title.
